slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
disgustingly disciplined

cold showers

end every shower with thirty seconds of cold water. choosing discomfort on purpose every morning trains your brain to stop negotiating with itself. it honestly works.

silent hours

pick one hour a day with no talking, no music and no phone. sitting with your own thoughts teaches focus in a way no planner or gadget ever could. it sounds simple, but very few people actually do it.

daily micro learning

spend 5 minutes learning a new topic every single morning, without skipping a single day. protecting one tiny streak teaches you to keep promises to yourself.
slides.texte_sophia:
daily micro learning

i spend 5 minutes every morning on one lesson in the Sophia app, a planet or a myth. never breaking that small streak made me disciplined in everything else too.

slides.texte_overlay:
reverse meals

eat dinner food for breakfast and breakfast food for dinner once a week. breaking small routines trains your brain to question its own autopilot. over time, it quietly changes how you feel every day.

backwards walking

walk backwards for a few minutes somewhere safe. when everything feels unfamiliar, your brain is forced to stay completely present and focused. the more you practise it, the more natural it becomes.
